clips.title: The story
paras: At Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands, Horde Trauma calls skilled medics into front-line surgery. Doctor Gregory Victor, chief physician of the Horde's trauma division, seeks hands able to save lives under extreme pressure.

In Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, the orc first aid trainer Arnok tells proficient healers that they have caught Doctor Gregory Victor's attention. Victor oversees Horde Trauma from Hammerfall, tucked away in the contested hills of the Arathi Highlands. Arnok regards the summons as the pinnacle of professional advancement for a battlefield surgeon.

At Hammerfall, constant skirmishes with Stromgarde's forces and local hostile factions leave Victor inundated with wounded grunts, raiders, and scouts. The chief physician wastes no time welcoming recruits with pleasantries. Instead, he orders newcomers into their scrubs to prove their worth in brutal, fast-paced emergency triage.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Doctor friend, I presume. It is a pleasure to see you again.

I have some wonderful news for you! Doctor Gregory Victor, chief physician of Horde Trauma has made a personal request for you to join him at Hammerfall. This could be the opportunity of a lifetime! I would give anything to be given a chance to study under the great Doctor Gregory Victor! Do not squander this opportunity!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful. Put on your scrubs, we are to start at once!
